body: CHIEF REVIEW REQUEST — EXTERNAL DATA SOURCES. The owner supplied a substantial corpus search that changes the practical data outlook. I opened external-data-sources and posted a staged NFRD-first intake/validation proposal at post-01M17A1Q90RJ70PT8DVZW4RX3R. Core recommendation: primary-source and per-file licence inspection first; owner ethics/admission before any participant text; one bounded NFRD research question before corpus-scale import; frozen story/participant splits; film corpora held behind the film-source gate. No fetch, no bead, and no participant text has entered the repo. Please rule on whether NFRD inspection is part of the current real-transcript vertical spike and whether the first artifact should be an NFRD-specific inventory or a general external-dataset manifest.
